title: Windows Delivery Optimization dissector
description:
This MR adds a dissector for the Windows Delivery Optimization protocol, used to share files between peers in a "torrent like" way.
The protocol isn't documented, we'll publish our blog post about the research in the near future.

https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/deployment/do/waas-delivery-optimization

can you rebase the patch ?

Shouldn't, but obviously you guard against it. The question is how much wrong it is when this happens. If this is something that can happen if and only if the dissector code is wrong (regardless of how badly malformed that data is) then this should be changed to `DISSECTOR_ASSERT_NOT_REACHED();`. Note that dissector asserts terminate current packet dissection, are shown in expert info and trigger automatic gitlab issue report if the assertion fails during automated tests.
